summary.en: The Golden State Warriors rallied from a 23-point first-quarter deficit to beat the Los Angeles Lakers 112-95 in their NBA Cup opener in San Francisco. Stephen Curry scored 31 points and moved past Dominique Wilkins into 18th on the NBA's all-time scoring list with 26,674 career points, capping his night by wrong-footing Luka Doncic for a three-pointer. Doncic led all scorers with 37 points for the Lakers.
summary.zh_hans: 金州勇士周五在NBA杯首战，主场112比95反胜洛杉矶湖人。湖人首节打出38比15，一度领先23分，勇士第二节回敬38比15，半场追成53平，下半场一举拉开。居里攻入31分，生涯总分达26,674分，超越韦坚斯升上历史得分榜第18位；比赛中他更晃倒东锡治后射入三分，成为全场经典一幕。东锡治为湖人攻入全场最高37分。
summary.zh_hant: 金州勇士周五在NBA盃首戰，主場112比95反勝洛杉磯湖人。湖人首節打出38比15，一度領先23分，勇士第二節回敬38比15，半場追成53平，下半場一舉拉開。居里攻入31分，生涯總分達26,674分，超越韋堅斯升上歷史得分榜第18位；比賽中他更晃倒東錫治後射入三分，成為全場經典一幕。東錫治為湖人攻入全場最高37分。

title.en: Curry scores 31 as Warriors rally past Lakers 112-95 in NBA Cup opener
title.zh_hans: NBA杯：勇士反胜湖人　居里31分兼超韦坚斯升历史第18
title.zh_hant: NBA盃：勇士反勝湖人　居里31分兼超韋堅斯升歷史第18

summary.en: LeBron James scored 20 points with nine rebounds and eight assists, sealing the Philadelphia 76ers' 98-93 win over the defending champion New York Knicks in their NBA Cup opener with a putback with 11.9 seconds left. Coach Nick Nurse called it the 41-year-old's best game since joining as a free agent in June. Tyrese Maxey led the Sixers with 27 points, while Jalen Brunson's 24 points and Karl-Anthony Towns' 22 points and 12 rebounds weren't enough for the Knicks.
summary.zh_hans: 费城七十六人周五在NBA杯首战，主场98比93险胜卫冕冠军纽约人。41岁的占士攻入20分、9篮板、8助攻，完场前11.9秒补篮得手锁定胜局，赛后获教练拿斯盛赞为加盟以来最佳一战。麦斯攻入全队最高27分；纽约人方面，宾逊在完场前1分32秒射入三分反超90比89，可惜未能守住胜果，宾逊得24分，唐斯贡献22分12篮板。
summary.zh_hant: 費城七十六人周五在NBA盃首戰，主場98比93險勝衛冕冠軍紐約人。41歲的占士攻入20分、9籃板、8助攻，完場前11.9秒補籃得手鎖定勝局，賽後獲教練拿斯盛讚為加盟以來最佳一戰。麥斯攻入全隊最高27分；紐約人方面，賓遜在完場前1分32秒射入三分反超90比89，可惜未能守住勝果，賓遜得24分，唐斯貢獻22分12籃板。

title.en: LeBron delivers late as 76ers edge Knicks 98-93 in NBA Cup opener
title.zh_hans: NBA杯：占士末段发威　七十六人98:93险胜纽约人
title.zh_hant: NBA盃：占士末段發威　七十六人98:93險勝紐約人

summary.en: Kyrie Irving scored 35 points and rookie Cooper Flagg added 33 points and nine rebounds as the Dallas Mavericks rallied from an 11-point second-half deficit to beat the Houston Rockets 116-111 in their NBA Cup opener, handing Houston its first defeat of the season. Kevin Durant led the Rockets with 28 points.
summary.zh_hans: 达拉斯独行侠周五在NBA杯首战，主场116比111击败侯斯顿火箭，送对手今季首场败仗。艾荣攻入35分，状元霍拉格贡献33分及9篮板，两人合轰68分，率队在下半场抹去11分落后劣势。杜兰特为火箭攻入28分。
summary.zh_hant: 達拉斯獨行俠周五在NBA盃首戰，主場116比111擊敗侯斯頓火箭，送對手今季首場敗仗。艾榮攻入35分，狀元霍拉格貢獻33分及9籃板，兩人合轟68分，率隊在下半場抹去11分落後劣勢。杜蘭特為火箭攻入28分。

title.en: Irving, Flagg combine for 68 as Mavericks hand Rockets first loss 116-111
title.zh_hans: NBA杯：艾荣35分霍拉格33分　独行侠送火箭今季首败
title.zh_hant: NBA盃：艾榮35分霍拉格33分　獨行俠送火箭今季首敗

title.en: Boozer's first career triple-double powers Grizzlies past Blazers 124-103 for 5-0 start
title.zh_hant: 布澤生涯首個大三元　灰熊 124:103 挫拓荒者開季五連勝
title.zh_hans: 布泽生涯首个大三元　灰熊 124:103 挫拓荒者开季五连胜

summary.en: No. 3 overall pick Cameron Boozer posted 18 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists for his first career triple-double as the Memphis Grizzlies beat the Portland Trail Blazers 124-103 on the road for a 5-0 start. At 19 years and 103 days, Boozer became the second-youngest player in NBA history with a triple-double, behind only Josh Giddey; Memphis outscored Portland 66-45 in the second half with eight players in double figures — Isaiah Stewart 18, Cedric Coward 17, Zach Edey 13 — for the franchise's second 5-0 start. Portland fell to 3-1 with its first loss; Deni Avdija had 24 points, nine rebounds and seven assists, while Ja Morant scored 14 against his former team before leaving in the fourth quarter with a left hamstring injury.
summary.zh_hant: 2026 年選秀探花卡梅倫·布澤交出 18 分、12 個籃板、12 次助攻，錄得生涯首個大三元，帶領曼菲斯灰熊作客以 124 比 103 擊敗波特蘭拓荒者，開季五連勝。19 歲 103 天的布澤成為 NBA 史上第二年輕的大三元球員，僅次於基迪；灰熊下半場打出 66 比 45，全隊 8 人得分雙位數，史超域 18 分、考沃德 17 分、伊迪 13 分，隊史第二次以 5 勝 0 負開季。拓荒者吞下今季首敗跌至 3 勝 1 負，艾夫迪亞 24 分 9 籃板 7 助攻；莫蘭特首度倒戈舊主攻入 14 分，但第四節左大腿筋受傷退場。
summary.zh_hans: 2026 年选秀探花卡梅伦·布泽交出 18 分、12 个篮板、12 次助攻，录得生涯首个大三元，带领曼菲斯灰熊作客以 124 比 103 击败波特兰拓荒者，开季五连胜。19 岁 103 天的布泽成为 NBA 史上第二年轻的大三元球员，仅次于基迪；灰熊下半场打出 66 比 45，全队 8 人得分双位数，史超域 18 分、考沃德 17 分、伊迪 13 分，队史第二次以 5 胜 0 负开季。拓荒者吞下今季首败跌至 3 胜 1 负，艾夫迪亚 24 分 9 篮板 7 助攻；莫兰特首度倒戈旧主攻入 14 分，但第四节左大腿筋受伤退场。

title.en: Fears' 22 points, 13 assists lift Pelicans past Kings 132-120 for first win
title.zh_hant: 菲爾斯 22 分 13 助攻　鵜鶘 132:120 挫國王奪今季首勝
title.zh_hans: 菲尔斯 22 分 13 助攻　鹈鹕 132:120 挫国王夺今季首胜

summary.en: Jeremiah Fears posted 22 points, 13 assists and eight rebounds while Zion Williamson shot 10-of-12 for 22 points as the New Orleans Pelicans beat the Sacramento Kings 132-120 at home for their first win after four straight losses, also the first victory for new coach Jamahl Mosley. New Orleans shot nearly 60 per cent, scoring 39 points in each of the second and third quarters with a 16-2 run to seal it; Trey Murphy III added 18 and the bench outscored Sacramento's 41-8. The Kings fell to 0-5 despite 19-year-old rookie Darius Acuff Jr.'s career-high 34 points — the third player in 40 seasons with two 30-point games in his first five. Domantas Sabonis had 15 rebounds but seven turnovers as Sacramento committed 25 turnovers and conceded 80 paint points.
summary.zh_hant: 謝利美亞·菲爾斯交出 22 分、13 次助攻、8 個籃板，施安·威廉遜 12 投 10 中攻入 22 分，紐奧爾良鵜鶘主場以 132 比 120 擊敗沙加緬度國王，終止開季四連敗，戰績 1 勝 4 負，新帥莫斯利亦取得執教首勝。鵜鶘全場投籃命中率近六成，第二、三節各攻 39 分，第三節中段一波 16 比 2 鎖定勝局，梅菲 18 分，替補得分 41 比 8 完勝。國王開季五連敗，19 歲新秀戴利阿斯·阿克夫攻入全場最高 34 分生涯新高，成為近 40 季第三位生涯前五戰兩度得分 30+ 的球員；沙邦尼斯 15 個籃板但 7 次失誤，國王全隊 25 次失誤、禁區失 80 分。
summary.zh_hans: 谢利美亚·菲尔斯交出 22 分、13 次助攻、8 个篮板，锡安·威廉逊 12 投 10 中攻入 22 分，新奥尔良鹈鹕主场以 132 比 120 击败沙加缅度国王，终止开季四连败，战绩 1 胜 4 负，新帅莫斯利亦取得执教首胜。鹈鹕全场投篮命中率近六成，第二、三节各攻 39 分，第三节中段一波 16 比 2 锁定胜局，梅菲 18 分，替补得分 41 比 8 完胜。国王开季五连败，19 岁新秀戴利亚斯·阿克夫攻入全场最高 34 分生涯新高，成为近 40 季第三位生涯前五战两度得分 30+ 的球员；沙邦尼斯 15 个篮板但 7 次失误，国王全队 25 次失误、禁区失 80 分。

title.en: Kowloon City fight back from two down to draw 2-2 with BC Rangers
title.zh_hant: 和富九龍城下半場連追兩球　2:2 逼和標準流浪
title.zh_hans: 和富九龙城下半场连追两球　2:2 逼和标准流浪

summary.en: Wofoo Kowloon City came from two goals down to draw 2-2 with BC Rangers in Friday's Hong Kong Premier League lone fixture at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground. Rangers led 2-0 at half-time through Paulinho's 7th-minute strike and Flavio Tico's 23rd-minute header, after Kowloon City had a 41st-minute effort from Keung Chun-yin ruled out for handball following a VAR review. Kowloon City hit back after the break, with Chan Ngo-hin pulling one back in the 65th minute before Nikola Popovic bundled home the equaliser in the 93rd minute. The point lifts Kowloon City to sixth in the table on five points.
summary.zh_hant: 港超聯周五（10月30日）獨腳戲，和富九龍城在啟德青年運動場主場出擊，半場落後兩球下，下半場連入兩球以2比2逼和標準流浪。流浪憑保利奧7分鐘門前燙射及法華利23分鐘飛身頭槌領先2比0；九龍城41分鐘曾由姜浚賢撞入一球，但經VAR覆核判手球在先，入球無效。換邊後九龍城全力反撲，陳傲軒65分鐘底線傳中掃射追近，補時3分鐘普波域門前撞入扳平。九龍城賽後以5分升上聯賽榜第6位。
summary.zh_hans: 港超联周五（10月30日）独脚戏，和富九龙城在启德青年运动场主场出击，半场落后两球下，下半场连入两球以2比2逼和标准流浪。流浪凭保利奥7分钟门前烫射及法华利23分钟飞身头槌领先2比0；九龙城41分钟曾由姜浚贤撞入一球，但经VAR覆核判手球在先，入球无效。换边后九龙城全力反扑，陈傲轩65分钟底线传中扫射追近，补时3分钟普波域门前撞入扳平。九龙城赛后以5分升上联赛榜第6位。

title.zh_hant: 香港國際六人板球賽　港隊首日1勝1負晉級Plate四強
title.zh_hans: 香港国际六人板球赛　港队首日1胜1负晋级Plate四强
title.en: Hong Kong International Sixes: hosts go 1-1 on day one, reach Plate semi-finals

summary.zh_hant: 香港國際六人板球賽昨日（10月30日）在旺角上演首日9場分組賽。港隊在A組首戰以107/4不敵澳洲135/4，輸28分；次戰反彈以149/5大勝英格蘭88/3，贏61分。港隊1勝1負以小組次名晉級Plate四強，今日下午2時15分出戰Plate第二場四強。澳洲小組全勝晉級盃賽四強。
summary.zh_hans: 香港国际六人板球赛昨日（10月30日）在旺角上演首日9场分组赛。港队在A组首战以107/4不敌澳洲135/4，输28分；次战反弹以149/5大胜英格兰88/3，赢61分。港队1胜1负以小组次名晋级Plate四强，今日下午2时15分出战Plate第二场四强。澳洲小组全胜晋级杯赛四强。
summary.en: Day one of the Hong Kong International Sixes saw nine group games at Mong Kok on October 30. Hosts Hong Kong lost their Group A opener to Australia by 28 runs (107/4 chasing 135/4) but bounced back to thrash England by 61 runs (149/5 vs 88/3). The 1-1 record sends Hong Kong into the Plate semi-finals as group runners-up, playing the second Plate semi-final today at 2:15pm. Australia topped the group to reach the Cup semi-finals.

title.zh_hant: 陳熠3比0橫掃世界第一王曼昱　晉級蒙彼利埃冠軍賽八強
title.zh_hans: 陈熠3比0横扫世界第一王曼昱　晋级蒙彼利埃冠军赛八强
title.en: Chen Yi stuns world No.1 Wang Manyu 3-0 to reach Montpellier Champions quarter-finals

summary.zh_hant: WTT蒙彼利埃冠軍賽女單16強上演國乒內戰，世界排名第9的陳熠以13比11、11比8、11比9直落三局，3比0淘汰世界第一、賽會頭號種子王曼昱，晉級女單八強。首局王曼昱9比7領先下，陳熠憑連續擦網擦邊球逆轉拿下；賽後陳熠坦言「運氣太好了」。剛奪亞錦賽女單冠軍的陳熠狀態正盛，雙方交手紀錄改寫為2比2。
summary.zh_hans: WTT蒙彼利埃冠军赛女单16强上演国乒内战，世界排名第9的陈熠以13比11、11比8、11比9直落三局，3比0淘汰世界第一、赛会头号种子王曼昱，晋级女单八强。首局王曼昱9比7领先下，陈熠凭连续擦网擦边球逆转拿下；赛后陈熠坦言「运气太好了」。刚夺亚锦赛女单冠军的陈熠状态正盛，双方交手纪录改写为2比2。
summary.en: China's Chen Yi, ranked world No.9, stunned top seed and world No.1 Wang Manyu 3-0 (13-11, 11-8, 11-9) in an all-Chinese round-of-16 clash at the WTT Montpellier Champions, reaching the women's singles quarter-finals. Wang led 9-7 in the opener before Chen Yi turned it around with a string of net cords and edge balls. Fresh from winning the Asian Championships singles title, Chen Yi levelled their head-to-head at 2-2.

title.zh_hant: 普列查轟30分　塞爾特人125:111挫公牛NBA盃開門紅
title.zh_hans: 普列查轰30分　塞尔特人125:111挫公牛NBA杯开门红
title.en: Pritchard drops 30 as Celtics beat Bulls 125-111 in NBA Cup opener

summary.zh_hant: 波士頓塞爾特人周五在NBA盃C組首戰，主場125比111擊敗芝加哥公牛，取得四連勝。後備上陣的普列查攻入全場最高30分，泰頓貢獻26分、7籃板、7助攻，佐治亦有18分；塞爾特人第二節一度領先32分。公牛方面，韋爾遜射入6記三分得23分，球隊吞下四連敗。
summary.zh_hans: 波士顿塞尔特人周五在NBA杯C组首战，主场125比111击败芝加哥公牛，取得四连胜。后备上阵的普列查攻入全场最高30分，泰顿贡献26分、7篮板、7助攻，佐治亦有18分；塞尔特人第二节一度领先32分。公牛方面，韦尔逊射入6记三分得23分，球队吞下四连败。
summary.en: The Boston Celtics opened NBA Cup Group C play with a 125-111 home win over the Chicago Bulls on Friday, their fourth straight victory. Payton Pritchard scored a game-high 30 points off the bench, Jayson Tatum added 26 points, seven rebounds and seven assists, and Paul George chipped in 18 as Boston led by as many as 32 in the second quarter. Caleb Wilson hit six three-pointers for a team-high 23 points as the Bulls dropped their fourth in a row.

title.zh_hant: 安迪杜古普大三元　熱火145:125挫溜馬開季主場首勝
title.zh_hans: 安迪杜古普大三元　热火145:125挫溜马开季主场首胜
title.en: Antetokounmpo's triple-double powers Heat past Pacers 145-125

summary.zh_hant: 邁阿密熱火周五在NBA盃首戰，主場145比125大勝印第安納溜馬，取得今季主場首勝。安迪杜古普交出31分、17籃板、10助攻，取得今季第二次大三元；艾迪巴約貢獻27分，湯臣射入7記三分得25分。熱火在中間兩節打出67比45的攻勢奠定勝局，取得兩連勝；溜馬的積遜後備得24分。
summary.zh_hans: 迈阿密热火周五在NBA杯首战，主场145比125大胜印第安纳溜马，取得今季主场首胜。安迪杜古普交出31分、17篮板、10助攻，取得今季第二次大三元；艾迪巴约贡献27分，汤臣射入7记三分得25分。热火在中间两节打出67比45的攻势奠定胜局，取得两连胜；溜马的积逊后备得24分。
summary.en: The Miami Heat opened NBA Cup play with a 145-125 home rout of the Indiana Pacers on Friday, their first home win of the season. Giannis Antetokounmpo posted 31 points, 17 rebounds and 10 assists for his second triple-double of the season, Bam Adebayo added 27 points and Klay Thompson hit seven three-pointers for 25. Miami outscored Indiana 67-46 across the middle two quarters to seal a second straight win, while Quenton Jackson scored 24 off the bench for the Pacers.

title.zh_hant: 卡比拿一箭定江山　愛斯賓奴1:0作客挫維拉利爾
title.zh_hans: 卡比拿一箭定江山　爱斯宾奴1:0作客挫维拉利尔
title.en: Cabrera strike gives Espanyol 1-0 win at Villarreal

summary.zh_hant: 西甲第11輪周五先賽一場，愛斯賓奴作客1比0擊敗維拉利爾。後衛卡比拿在60分鐘攻入全場唯一入球，為客軍帶來寶貴三分。愛斯賓奴賽後以11分升上第14位，脫離降班區；維拉利爾12分續排第10位。
summary.zh_hans: 西甲第11轮周五先赛一场，爱斯宾奴作客1比0击败维拉利尔。后卫卡比拿在60分钟攻入全场唯一入球，为客军带来宝贵三分。爱斯宾奴赛后以11分升上第14位，脱离降班区；维拉利尔12分续排第10位。
summary.en: Espanyol beat Villarreal 1-0 away in Friday's La Liga round 11 opener. Defender Leandro Cabrera scored the game's only goal in the 60th minute to secure three valuable points for the visitors. Espanyol climb to 14th on 11 points, clear of the relegation zone, while Villarreal stay 10th on 12 points.

Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 at Stamford Bridge in the Premier League's matchday 9. Morgan Rogers broke through midfield to chip home the opener five minutes after half-time; Lisandro Martinez was sent off for two yellows and conceded a penalty, which Cole Palmer converted in the 64th minute for his 50th Premier League goal. United are winless in nine in all competitions (D3 L6) and sit 16th, while Chelsea move up to fourth.

summary.en: Atletico Madrid won 2-0 away at Levante to move provisionally top of LaLiga. Alejandro Grimaldo seized on a defensive error to score his fourth league goal of the season in the 36th minute, and Giuliano Simeone finished off an Alex Baena through ball in the 62nd. Atletico have won seven straight league games and are unbeaten in nine in all competitions; Diego Simeone equalled Luis Aragones' record of 344 LaLiga wins as a coach.

summary.en: All three Hong Kong players fell in the first round of women's singles qualifying at the Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open 2026 at Victoria Park today. 21-year-old Cody Wong lost 4-6, 2-6 to second seed Himeno Sakatsume; Katherine Ip pushed top seed Aliaksandra Sasnovich hard, fighting back to 4-5 in the first set before losing 4-6, 2-6, winning applause for her winners; and wildcard Chloe Cheng fell 1-6, 2-6 to Carol Young Suh Lee. In the main draw, Adithya Karunaratne faces sixth seed Wang Xinyu in round one.

summary.zh_hant: 「保誠香港網球公開賽2026」女單資格賽今日在維園開打，三位港將全部首圈出局。21歲的石卓盈面對頭號種子莎絲洛域治，首盤一度追近至4:5，最終以4:6、2:6落敗，但頻頻打出「靚波」贏得全場掌聲。王康怡以4:6、2:6不敵2號種子坂詰姬野，黎清嵐則以1:6、2:6敗給美國球手李英洙。女單正賽已抽籤，李芬首圈將鬥6號種子王欣瑜。

summary.en: The Orlando Magic beat the Toronto Raptors 121-114 on the road in NBA Cup group play, avenging a 30-point loss three days earlier. Toronto's Scottie Barnes scored a career-high 41 points on 19-of-34 shooting but fouled out late; Desmond Bane had 28 points and Franz Wagner added 26 points and 11 assists for Orlando, who shot 18-of-34 from three. With Kawhi Leonard sidelined by knee swelling, Toronto have lost two of their last three.

summary.zh_hant: NBA盃小組賽，魔術作客121比114擊敗速龍，報回三日前慘敗30分之仇。速龍史葛迪·班尼斯34投19中攻入生涯新高41分，惜最後犯滿離場；魔術班尼28分、華格拿26分11助攻，全隊三分34投18中。速龍在膝傷的尼納特缺陣下，近三場輸了兩場。

title.en: Barnes' career-high 41 not enough as Raptors fall 121-114 to Magic in NBA Cup

summary.en: The Denver Nuggets beat the Phoenix Suns 127-120 on the road in NBA Cup group play. Jamal Murray scored 39 points on 7-of-9 three-point shooting, Christian Braun added 31 and Nikola Jokic posted 18 points, 7 rebounds and 10 assists. Denver hit 20 three-pointers; Phoenix's Dillon Brooks was ejected in the third quarter for a Flagrant 2 foul on Murray. It was Denver's first NBA Cup win of the season.
